set.body:
Current plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md, Full event-graph delivery. Owner approved proceeding 2026-11-16.

Scope: Extend the first compiler beyond its deliberate Held gaps, using checked holder, context and playback evidence. Reuse ADRs 0024/0026 and SpeechPromotion; promotion remains an overlay, never an ordinary root-world fact. No new context ontology without its ADR decision.

Engineering acceptance artifact: One public-path witness bundle distinguishes depicted, reported, believed/intended and unresolved content. Unsupported holder/context placement gaps explicitly; reported content stays out of root facts; a licensed speech promotion remains a separately bound overlay. A compiled fallback mutant fails its named assertion.

Scope is one bounded synthetic account and its public path, not a whole-corpus extraction. Use repository reference-scope gates, relevant mutation/compile-refusal evidence and exact-SHA cold review. Graph-wide integration and fresh-data qualification remain on the existing E0 and human-evaluation tickets. Claim this slice, not a parent container.
set.title: [event-graph] Admit anchored contexts and integrate speech overlays
